ui.title: TAROT READIN'
ui.sandboxDrawn: {name} COMES OFF DA TOP OF DA DECK!
ui.sandboxDeckEmpty: DERE IZ NOTHIN' LEFT IN DA DECK!
ui.sandboxScrambled: {count} CARDS, FACE DOWN, ALL OVER DA CLOTH!
ui.sandboxGathered: EVERY CARD IZ BACK IN DA DECK!
ui.sandboxCastleFew: TOO FEW CARDS ON DA TABLE TA BUILD ANYTHIN'!
ui.sandboxCutDone: DA DECK IZ CUT AN' SET BACK DOWN!

The Fool.name: DA FOOL
upright: NEW BEGINNINGS AWAIT YOU WIT CHILDLIKE WONDER AN' ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES!
TAKE A LEAP OF FAITH AN' TRUST IN DA JOURNEY AHEAD OF YOU!
EMBRACE SPONTANEITY AN' LET YA FREE SPIRIT GUIDE YA PATH!
ADVENTURE CALLS TA YOU, URGIN' YOU TA STEP INTO DA UNKNOWN!
reversed: RECKLESSNESS CLOUDS YA JUDGMENT AN' LEADS TA POOR DECISIONS!
FEAR OF TAKIN' NECESSARY RISKS HOLDS YOU BACK FROM GROWTH!
NAIVETY MAY CAUSE YOU TA OVERLOOK IMPORTANT WARNIN' SIGNS!
CHAOS AN' LACK OF DIRECTION CREATE UNNECESSARY OBSTACLES!

The Magician.name: DA MAGICIAN
upright: YOU POSSESS ALL DA TOOLS NEEDED TA MANIFEST YA DESIRES!
YA WILLPOWER AN' DETERMINATION CREATE POWERFUL TRANSFORMATIONS!
FOCUS YA ENERGY TA TURN DREAMS INTO TANGIBLE REALITY!
MASTERY OF YA SKILLS BRINGS SUCCESS WITHIN REACH!
reversed: MANIPULATION AN' DECEIT MAY BE PRESENT IN YA SURROUNDINGS!
YA TALENTS REMAIN UNTAPPED DUE TA LACK OF CONFIDENCE!
ILLUSIONS AN' TRICKERY CLOUD DA TRUTH FROM YA VISION!
POOR PLANNIN' PREVENTS YA GOALS FROM MATERIALIZIN'!

The High Priestess.name: DA HIGH PRIESTESS
upright: TRUST YA INTUITION AS IT GUIDES YOU TOWARD HIDDEN TRUTHS!
SACRED KNOWLEDGE REVEALS ITSELF THROUGH QUIET CONTEMPLATION!
DA SUBCONSCIOUS MIND HOLDS ANSWERS TA YA DEEPEST QUESTIONS!
MYSTERY AN' FEMININE WISDOM ILLUMINATE YA SPIRITUAL PATH!
reversed: DISCONNECTION FROM YA INNER VOICE CREATES CONFUSION!
SECRETS AN' HIDDEN AGENDAS MAY DISRUPT YA PEACE!
IGNORIN' YA INTUITION LEADS YOU AWAY FROM TRUTH!
SURFACE-LEVEL THINKIN' PREVENTS DEEPER UNDERSTANDIN'!

The Empress.name: DA EMPRESS
upright: ABUNDANCE FLOWS NATURALLY INTO ALL AREAS OF YA LIFE!
CREATIVE ENERGY BLOSSOMS AN' BRINGS NEW PROJECTS TA FRUITION!
NURTURIN' RELATIONSHIPS PROVIDE COMFORT AN' EMOTIONAL FULFILLMENT!
NATURAL BEAUTY AN' SENSUALITY ENHANCE YA PERSONAL MAGNETISM!
reversed: CREATIVE BLOCKS STIFLE YA SELF-EXPRESSION AN' GROWTH!
NEGLECTIN' SELF-CARE DEPLETES YA ENERGY RESERVES!
CODEPENDENCY CREATES IMBALANCE IN YA RELATIONSHIPS!
MATERIAL CONCERNS OVERSHADOW EMOTIONAL NEEDS!

The Emperor.name: DA EMPEROR
upright: LEADERSHIP AN' AUTHORITY POSITION YOU FOR GREATER SUCCESS!
STRUCTURE AN' DISCIPLINE CREATE A SOLID FOUNDATION FOR GROWTH!
YA PROTECTIVE NATURE SHIELDS LOVED ONES FROM HARM!
STRATEGIC THINKIN' LEADS TA LONG-TERM ACHIEVEMENTS!
reversed: TYRANNICAL BEHAVIOR DAMAGES IMPORTANT RELATIONSHIPS!
RIGIDITY PREVENTS ADAPTATION TA CHANGIN' CIRCUMSTANCES!
ABUSE OF POWER CREATES RESISTANCE AN' REBELLION!
LACK OF SELF-DISCIPLINE UNDERMINES YA AUTHORITY!

The Hierophant.name: DA HIEROPHANT
upright: TRADITIONAL WISDOM PROVIDES GUIDANCE FOR CURRENT CHALLENGES!
SPIRITUAL TEACHINGS DEEPEN YA UNDERSTANDIN' OF LIFE'S PURPOSE!
CONFORMITY TA ESTABLISHED SYSTEMS BRINGS ACCEPTANCE AN' BELONGIN'!
MENTORSHIP ACCELERATES YA LEARNIN' AN' PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT!
reversed: REBELLION AGAINST TRADITION OPENS NEW PATHS OF UNDERSTANDIN'!
DOGMATIC THINKIN' LIMITS YA PERSPECTIVE AN' GROWTH!
QUESTION AUTHORITY TA DISCOVER YA AUTHENTIC TRUTH!
UNCONVENTIONAL APPROACHES YIELD SURPRISIN' RESULTS!

The Lovers.name: DA LOVERS
upright: DEEP CONNECTIONS AN' MEANINGFUL RELATIONSHIPS ENRICH YA LIFE!
IMPORTANT CHOICES ALIGN WIT YA VALUES AN' DESIRES!
HARMONY BETWEEN OPPOSITES CREATES PERFECT BALANCE!
LOVE IN ALL FORMS ELEVATES YA CONSCIOUSNESS!
reversed: DISHARMONY IN RELATIONSHIPS REQUIRES HONEST COMMUNICATION!
INNER CONFLICTS PREVENT YOU FROM MAKIN' CLEAR DECISIONS!
TEMPTATION LEADS YOU AWAY FROM YA TRUE PATH!
IMBALANCED PARTNERSHIPS DRAIN YA EMOTIONAL ENERGY!

The Chariot.name: DA CHARIOT
upright: DETERMINATION AN' WILLPOWER DRIVE YOU TOWARD VICTORY!
OPPOSIN' FORCES UNITE UNDER YA SKILLED DIRECTION!
SELF-DISCIPLINE PROPELS YOU PAST ANY OBSTACLE!
TRIUMPHANT PROGRESS REWARDS YA FOCUSED EFFORTS!
reversed: LACK OF DIRECTION SCATTERS YA ENERGY INEFFECTIVELY!
AGGRESSION AN' FORCE CREATE UNNECESSARY CONFLICT!
LOSS OF CONTROL DERAILS YA CAREFULLY LAID PLANS!
OPPOSITION SEEMS INSURMOUNTABLE WITHOUT PROPER STRATEGY!

Strength.name: STRENGTH
upright: INNER STRENGTH AN' COURAGE OVERCOME EXTERNAL CHALLENGES!
GENTLE PERSISTENCE TAMES DA WILDEST ASPECTS OF LIFE!
COMPASSION TRANSFORMS POTENTIAL BAD 'UNS INTO ALLIES!
PATIENT ENDURANCE LEADS TA EVENTUAL TRIUMPH!
reversed: SELF-DOUBT WEAKENS YA RESOLVE AN' PERSONAL POWER!
RAW EMOTIONS OVERPOWER LOGICAL THINKIN' AN' PLANNIN'!
INSECURITY MANIFESTS AS EITHER AGGRESSION OR TIMIDITY!
INNER BEASTS REQUIRE ACKNOWLEDGMENT AN' INTEGRATION!

The Hermit.name: DA HERMIT
upright: SOLITUDE BRINGS PROFOUND INSIGHTS AN' SELF-DISCOVERY!
INNER WISDOM ILLUMINATES DA PATH FORWARD!
SPIRITUAL SEARCHIN' LEADS TA MEANINGFUL REVELATIONS!
WITHDRAWAL FROM CHAOS ALLOWS DEEP CONTEMPLATION!
reversed: ISOLATION BECOMES LONELINESS WITHOUT PURPOSE OR GROWTH!
EXCESSIVE WITHDRAWAL CREATES DISCONNECTION FROM REALITY!
FEAR OF EXAMINATION PREVENTS NECESSARY SELF-REFLECTION!
STUBBORN RECLUSIVENESS BLOCKS HELPFUL CONNECTIONS!

Wheel of Fortune.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE
upright: DESTINY TURNS IN YA FAVOR BRINGIN' UNEXPECTED OPPORTUNITIES!
CYCLES OF CHANGE USHER IN NEW PHASES OF EXISTENCE!
GOOD FORTUNE SMILES UPON YA CURRENT ENDEAVORS!
UNIVERSAL FORCES ALIGN TA SUPPORT YA HIGHEST GOOD!
reversed: MISFORTUNE TEMPORARILY DISRUPTS YA PLANNED TRAJECTORY!
RESISTANCE TA CHANGE PROLONGS DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES!
EXTERNAL FORCES SEEM TA WORK AGAINST YA DESIRES!
BREAKIN' NEGATIVE CYCLES REQUIRES CONSCIOUS EFFORT!

Justice.name: JUSTICE
upright: TRUTH AN' FAIRNESS PREVAIL IN ALL MATTERS AT HAND!
KARMIC BALANCE RESTORES ORDER TA CHAOTIC SITUATIONS!
LEGAL MATTERS RESOLVE IN ALIGNMENT WIT HIGHEST JUSTICE!
ACCOUNTABILITY FOR ACTIONS BRINGS APPROPRIATE CONSEQUENCES!
reversed: INJUSTICE AN' UNFAIRNESS CLOUD CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES!
DISHONESTY COMPLICATES LEGAL OR ETHICAL MATTERS!
AVOIDIN' ACCOUNTABILITY DELAYS INEVITABLE RECKONIN'!
BIAS PREVENTS CLEAR AN' BALANCED JUDGMENT!

The Hanged Man.name: DA HANGED MAN
upright: SURRENDER AN' RELEASE BRING UNEXPECTED ENLIGHTENMENT!
NEW PERSPECTIVES EMERGE FROM LETTIN' GO OF CONTROL!
SACRIFICE NOW LEADS TA GREATER GAINS LATER!
SUSPENSION OF ACTION ALLOWS WISDOM TA SURFACE!
reversed: STUBBORN RESISTANCE PROLONGS UNNECESSARY SUFFERIN'!
MARTYRDOM WITHOUT PURPOSE DRAINS VITAL ENERGY!
STAGNATION RESULTS FROM FEAR OF NECESSARY CHANGE!
INDECISION PARALYZES FORWARD MOVEMENT!

Death.name: DEATH
upright: TRANSFORMATION CLEARS SPACE FOR POWERFUL REBIRTH!
ENDINGS CREATE OPPORTUNITIES FOR NEW BEGINNINGS!
RELEASE OF DA OLD MAKES ROOM FOR FRESH GROWTH!
PROFOUND CHANGE RESHAPES YA ENTIRE EXISTENCE!
reversed: RESISTANCE TA ENDINGS PROLONGS DECAY AN' STAGNATION!
FEAR OF CHANGE KEEPS YOU TRAPPED IN LIMITIN' PATTERNS!
CLINGIN' TA DA PAST PREVENTS FORWARD EVOLUTION!
INCOMPLETE TRANSITIONS LEAVE YOU BETWEEN WORLDS!

Temperance.name: TEMPERANCE
upright: PERFECT BALANCE CREATES HARMONY IN ALL LIFE AREAS!
PATIENCE AN' MODERATION LEAD TA LASTIN' SUCCESS!
BLENDIN' OPPOSITES CREATES POWERFUL ALCHEMY!
DIVINE TIMIN' ORCHESTRATES PERFECT OUTCOMES!
reversed: IMBALANCE AN' EXCESS DISRUPT YA EQUILIBRIUM!
IMPATIENCE RUSHES PROCESSES REQUIRIN' CAREFUL TIMIN'!
CONFLICTIN' DESIRES CREATE INTERNAL DISCORD!
LACK OF MODERATION LEADS TA UNFORTUNATE EXTREMES!

The Devil.name: DA DEVIL
upright: MATERIAL DESIRES AN' EARTHLY PLEASURES DEMAND EXAMINATION!
SHADOW ASPECTS REQUIRE ACKNOWLEDGMENT AN' INTEGRATION!
BONDAGE TA UNHEALTHY PATTERNS BECOMES APPARENT!
TEMPTATION TESTS YA COMMITMENT TA GROWTH!
reversed: LIBERATION FROM LIMITIN' BELIEFS SETS YOU FREE!
BREAKIN' UNHEALTHY PATTERNS RESTORES PERSONAL POWER!
RECOGNITION OF ILLUSIONS DISPELS DEY INFLUENCE!
RELEASE FROM BONDAGE OPENS NEW POSSIBILITIES!

The Tower.name: DA TOWER
upright: SUDDEN UPHEAVAL DESTROYS FALSE FOUNDATIONS!
BREAKTHROUGH MOMENTS SHATTER LIMITIN' ILLUSIONS!
CHAOS PRECEDES NECESSARY RECONSTRUCTION!
DIVINE INTERVENTION REDIRECTS YA LIFE PATH!
reversed: AVOIDIN' NECESSARY DESTRUCTION PROLONGS INSTABILITY!
FEAR OF CHANGE MAINTAINS CRUMBLIN' STRUCTURES!
GRADUAL TRANSFORMATION REPLACES SUDDEN UPHEAVAL!
DISASTER NARROWLY AVOIDED TEACHES IMPORTANT LESSONS!

The Star.name: DA STAR
upright: HOPE ILLUMINATES EVEN DA DARKEST MOMENTS!
SPIRITUAL RENEWAL RESTORES FAITH AN' OPTIMISM!
DIVINE INSPIRATION GUIDES YA CREATIVE EXPRESSION!
HEALIN' WATERS WASH AWAY PAST WOUNDS!
reversed: DESPAIR CLOUDS YA VISION OF FUTURE POSSIBILITIES!
DISCONNECTION FROM FAITH CREATES SPIRITUAL EMPTINESS!
CREATIVE BLOCKS STIFLE INSPIRED EXPRESSION!
PESSIMISM PREVENTS RECOGNITION OF BLESSINGS!

The Moon.name: DA MOON
upright: ILLUSIONS AN' DECEPTIONS REQUIRE CAREFUL NAVIGATION!
INTUITIVE WISDOM EMERGES FROM SUBCONSCIOUS DEPTHS!
DREAMS AN' VISIONS CARRY IMPORTANT MESSAGES!
HIDDEN FEARS SURFACE FOR HEALIN' AN' RELEASE!
reversed: CONFUSION LIFTS AS CLARITY RETURNS TA YA VISION!
DECEPTIONS REVEALED ALLOW TRUTH TA EMERGE!
REPRESSED EMOTIONS DEMAND CONSCIOUS ATTENTION!
MENTAL FOG CLEARS REVEALIN' DA PATH AHEAD!

The Sun.name: DA SUN
upright: JOY AN' VITALITY INFUSE EVERY ASPECT OF EXISTENCE!
SUCCESS AN' RECOGNITION REWARD YA AUTHENTIC EXPRESSION!
CHILDLIKE WONDER REVEALS LIFE'S SIMPLE PLEASURES!
RADIANT ENERGY ATTRACTS ABUNDANCE AN' BLESSINGS!
reversed: TEMPORARY CLOUDS OBSCURE YA INNER RADIANCE!
EGO INFLATION DISTORTS GENUINE ACCOMPLISHMENTS!
FORCED POSITIVITY MASKS UNDERLYIN' ISSUES!
DELAYED SUCCESS TESTS YA PATIENCE AN' FAITH!

Judgement.name: JUDGEMENT
upright: SPIRITUAL AWAKENIN' TRANSFORMS YA ENTIRE BEING!
PAST ACTIONS RECEIVE FAIR AN' FINAL EVALUATION!
REBIRTH FOLLOWS HONEST SELF-ASSESSMENT!
HIGHER CALLIN' DEMANDS COURAGEOUS RESPONSE!
reversed: SELF-JUDGMENT BLOCKS FORGIVENESS AN' GROWTH!
AVOIDIN' INNER CALLIN' CREATES PERSISTENT DISSATISFACTION!
PAST MISTAKES HAUNT PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES!
FEAR OF JUDGMENT PARALYZES DECISIVE ACTION!

The World.name: DA WORLD
upright: COMPLETION OF MAJOR CYCLES BRINGS DEEP SATISFACTION!
WHOLENESS AN' INTEGRATION CREATE PERFECT HARMONY!
WORLDLY SUCCESS REFLECTS INNER ACCOMPLISHMENT!
UNIVERSAL CONSCIOUSNESS EXPANDS YA AWARENESS!
reversed: INCOMPLETE VENTURES REQUIRE ADDITIONAL EFFORT!
EXTERNAL SUCCESS FEELS EMPTY WITHOUT INNER FULFILLMENT!
SHORTCUTS PREVENT GENUINE ACCOMPLISHMENT!
LIMITED PERSPECTIVE RESTRICTS FULL POTENTIAL!

three.name: DA THREE FATES
three.blurb: THREE CARDS: PAST, PRESENT AN' FUTURE!

horseshoe.name: DA HORSESHOE
horseshoe.blurb: SEVEN CARDS LAID IN AN ARC!

celtic.name: DA CELTIC CROSS
celtic.blurb: TEN CARDS IN A CELTIC CROSS!

npc.name: VILLAGER
npc.perfect: AMAZIN'! YA READIN' WAZ PERFECTLY ACCURATE!
npc.good: GOOD READIN'! YOU GOT MOST OF IT RIGHT!
npc.poor: DAT READIN' NO RESONATE WIT ME AT ALL...
npc.perfectLong:
AMAZIN'! YA READIN' WAZ PERFECTLY ACCURATE!
ME IZ IMPRESSED BY YA MYSTICAL ABILITIES!
npc.goodLong:
GOOD READIN'! YOU GOT MOST OF IT RIGHT.
YOU HAB REAL POTENTIAL AS A FORTUNE TELLER!
npc.averageLong:
YA READIN' WAZ PARTIALLY CORRECT.
PERHAPS YOU NEED MORE PRACTICE WIT DA CARDS!
npc.poorLong:
DAT READIN' NO RESONATE WIT ME AT ALL...
MAYBE DA SPIRITS NO WAZ SPEAKIN' CLEARLY TODAY!
